theorems.name: Submission.dpfir_integral_eq_of_area_lintegral
theorems.statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (μ ν : Measure (Euclid P)) (φ : Euclid P → Euclid P) (J h f : Euclid P → ℝ), (∀ x, 0 ≤ J x) → (∀ g : Euclid P → ℝ≥0∞, ∫⁻ y, g y ∂ν = ∫⁻ x, ENNReal.ofReal (J x) * g (φ x) ∂μ) → AEStronglyMeasurable h ν → Integrable f μ → (∀ᵐ x ∂μ, J x * h (φ x) = f x) → Integrable h ν ∧ ∫ y, h y ∂ν = ∫ x, f x ∂μ
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
